resources.string: Save everything (food log, foods, recipes, saved meals, weight, water, activity, photo estimates, goals and settings) as one file you can keep anywhere. API keys are never included.

Merge adds what\'s new and keeps whichever copy was edited last. Replace deletes everything on this phone first.
Everything on this phone will be deleted and replaced with the backup, including settings. A safety copy of your current data is saved first, so you can undo this from Backup & data.

A separate file with every setting, your AI profiles and their API keys, and the food database key. It\'s locked with a passphrase you choose. Use it to set up another phone.
Anyone with this file and the passphrase can use your API keys. There is no way to recover a forgotten passphrase.
Weak. A few unrelated words are stronger.
